full_page.content:
1948, July 3
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F.M. Cap.
Saint Felix Capuchin Friary Huntington, Indiana Bles'd be God in His Angels and in His Saints! July 3rd, 48
God bless you Miss Krausman.
Evidently M. does not love God as is the first duty of every one of us - to try to love Him.
What's to be done? We'll simply have to have patience, humble ourselves and wait .... Praying in meantime that the Good God increase our faith and confidence in Him till we can appreciate creatures as of secondary importance. Then possibly it will come natural for us to act naturally and tell what's honestly in our minds and hearts.
In the mean time we'll pray on and wait God's mercy.
Sincerely in Christ,
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
